content: We exploit online training with a mini-batch size 128 to learn model parameters. The max-epoch iteration is set by 200, and the best-epoch model is chosen according to the development performances. We use RMSprop BIBREF28 with a learning rate $10^{-3}$ to update model parameters, and use $l_2$ -regularization by a parameter $10^{-5}$ . We adopt the dropout technique to avoid overfitting by a drop value of $0.2$ .
